description: Record a payment received against an issued invoice: how it was paid, the amount in the invoice's currency (a decimal STRING), the day, and the payment's own reference. The invoice is read first: a cancelled one, one paid in full, or an amount over what it still owes is refused with nothing recorded, and a payment already on it with the same type, reference, amount and date is not recorded again (the answer says alreadyRecorded). The answer carries the balance before and after. list_invoices with status unpaid finds what is owed. Moves money or makes a legal document: the client asks the user to approve each call.

amount.description: The amount paid, in the invoice's currency, as a decimal STRING ("1210.00"), at most two decimals and at most what the invoice still owes.

date.description: The day it was paid, YYYY-MM-DD.

document_number.description: The payment's own reference ("OP 7001"), required for every type but Chitanta.

idempotency_key.description: Leave it out: a retry with the same arguments then finds the payment if it landed and records nothing. Give a key of your own only to record a second payment identical in type, reference, amount and date.

number.description: The document number as text, without its series: "0042" is not 42.

receipt_series.description: For a Chitanta: the receipt series from list_series. Oblio numbers the receipt.

series_name.description: The document's series, exactly as list_series shows it.

type.description: How it was paid, in Oblio's words: "Ordin de plata" for a bank transfer, "Card", "Chitanta" for cash with a receipt, and so on.

name: collect_invoice
title: Record a payment on an invoice
